pokedexEntries.di: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

pokedexEntries.prl: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

pokedexEntries.pt: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.
